name: Kōfu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kōfu town emblem in white: a ring divided by a vertical bar, crossed by winged horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kōfu, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted in June 1985; the emblem dates from December 1954.

features.role: Kōfu town emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar, crossed by winged horizontal strokes
